7353.title: Preserve the original send failure when recovery metadata is unavailable
7353.rootCauseOneLine: An unguarded metadata lookup rejects inside the send error handler, replacing the original environment-unavailable error.
7353.proposedFix: Treat recovery metadata as best effort and return the original send error if the lookup fails.
7353.caveats: Deterministic CLI command/output test with stubbed HTTP responses and real SDK error decoding; no live server-stop race or provider was needed. Both clean runs were performed by the same agent. The optional new-thread command suggestion is a separate convenience improvement.
